title: QuayOps scenario, format v1
description: A QuayOps STS quay crane scenario: the vessel and its bay plan on arrival, the load list, the work queue of crane moves, the yard side under the crane, environment, crane start state and rules. Units are SI and carried in the field-name suffix (_m metres, _cm centimetres, _t tonnes, _s seconds, _kn knots, _deg degrees, _mps m/s, _C °C). Every object is strict: unknown keys are errors. Plain JSON only: duplicate keys and comments are errors; an integer written as 20.0 is accepted. Every `default` is a fixed constant of format v1 (changed only with a new schemaVersion): write only what differs from the defaults; an explicit value pins it. Exception: omitted rules fields come from the tunable rules-defaults profile. This schema checks structure, types, enums, ranges, patterns and simple conditionals only. The ScenarioLoader performs further checks on load: ISO 6346 and IMO check digits, duplicate ids, cross-references between work queue, bay plan, load list and yard side, bay/row/tier existence for this vessel, physical stowage, hatch cover coverage, crane reach, and a sequence dry run of the work queue.

$schema.description: Editor hint: path or URL of this JSON Schema, e.g. "./Schema/quayops-scenario.v1.schema.json". Ignored by the simulator.

schemaVersion.description: Scenario format version. This build reads version 1 only. New optional fields do not bump it; breaking changes do.

scenario.description: Scenario identity and metadata shown in the scenario browser.

id.description: Scenario id: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, 3–64 characters, starting with a letter or digit, e.g. "deepsea-bay22-mixed". It is the scenario browser key and the stem of the results file name; keep it equal to the file name without ".json" (the loader warns if it differs, the browser flags two files with the same id).

title.description: Title shown in the scenario browser.

description.description: Free-text briefing shown in the scenario browser.

quay.description: Berth geometry. All fields optional; an omitted field takes its fixed format default (schema v1).

length_m.description: Quay (berth) length in metres from quay mark 0. The vessel must lie between 0 and this value.

marksIncreaseTo.description: Direction in which the quay marks increase for someone standing on the quay FACING THE WATER: "right" or "left". World X (+X = the observer's right) = quay mark ("right") or length_m − quay mark ("left"). All quay marks in the file stay real marks.

orientation_deg.description: True bearing in degrees of the direction of increasing quay marks. The world +X axis points to this bearing (marksIncreaseTo "right") or to this bearing + 180° ("left"); the water side (+Z) lies at the +X bearing − 90°. Converts the true wind direction into crane-relative wind.

watersideRailToFenderLine_m.description: Distance in metres from the waterside rail centreline to the fender line (face of the fenders).

apronAboveWaterline_m.description: Height in metres of the quay apron / rail head (Y = 0) above the water level, i.e. the tide state; > 0. Sets the vessel's vertical position. The loader warns outside 1.5–8 m.

vessel.description: The vessel alongside: particulars, mooring, hull structure, bay/row/tier geometry, hatch covers, lashing bridges and reefer plugs.

imo.description: IMO number, 7 digits as a string, e.g. "9999993". The loader validates the check digit.

draught_m.description: Current draught in metres (waterline to keel).

deckHeightAboveWaterline_m.description: Freeboard in metres: main deck at side above the waterline.

sideAlongside.description: Side alongside the quay, in world terms: "starboard" ⇒ the bow points to world +X (to the right of someone on the quay facing the water); "port" ⇒ the bow points to world −X. That means "bow towards increasing quay marks" for starboard only when quay.marksIncreaseTo is "right".

bowAtQuayMark_m.description: Real quay mark in metres abeam the bow (forward end of LOA).

offFender_m.description: Gap in metres between the fender line and the ship's side (0 = lying against the fenders).

structure.description: Hull structure details. Every field has a fixed format default (schema v1); write only what differs.

tankTopAboveKeel_m.description: Height in metres of the tank top (hold floor = base of the first hold tier) above the keel.

hatchCoamingHeight_m.description: Height in metres of the hatch coaming above the main deck at side; hatch cover underside = main deck + coaming.

rowPitch_m.description: Athwartships distance in metres between adjacent row centrelines (2.438 m box width + cell guide / lashing clearance).

firstHoldTier.description: Tier number of the lowest hold tier (even, normally 02). Hold tiers count up in steps of 2. The hold tier range must end below firstDeckTier (loader error).

firstDeckTier.description: Tier number of the lowest deck tier on the hatch covers (even, normally 82; vessels with many deck tiers use 80 or 72). Deck tiers count up in steps of 2; the highest tier of every bay must be ≤ 98 (loader error).

cellGuides.description: Where cell guides are fitted. Boxes in cell guides stack directly on each other (0 m gap); elsewhere a 0.03 m stacking-cone gap is added between boxes.

hold.description: true = cell guides in the holds.

deck.description: true = cell guides on deck (e.g. open-hatch vessel); they are 40 ft guides, so no 45 ft box stands in them.

bays.description: Longitudinal bay layout and default row/tier counts. Bays are numbered from the bow by walking over the odd numbers 1, 3, 5, …: an odd number listed in twentyOnlyBays is a lone 20 ft bay (length pitch_m/2) and the walk goes on at the next odd number; otherwise it and the next odd number form a 40 ft bay (e.g. 01 + 03 = 02, length pitch_m) and the walk goes on after both. Without twentyOnlyBays the 40 ft bays are 02, 06, 10, …. A 40 ft bay B spans the 20 ft bays B−1 (forward, centre −3.067 m) and B+1 (aft, +3.067 m).

count.description: Number of 40 ft bays; the walk stops after this many (lone 20 ft bays are extra positions). Without twentyOnlyBays: bays 02, 06, …, 4N−2.

firstBayCentreFromBow_m.description: Distance in metres from the bow (forward end of LOA) to the centre of the first bay position (40 ft bay 02, or the lone 20 ft bay 01).

pitch_m.description: Length of one 40 ft bay position in metres (a lone 20 ft bay counts pitch_m/2). Each next bay centre = previous centre + (previous length + next length)/2 + the length of any gap after the previous bay; for 40 ft bays that is pitch_m between centres.

twentyOnlyBays.description: Odd bay numbers that are lone 20 ft bays (e.g. a short forward hold), in any order. Shifts the numbering of every bay aft of them: [1] ⇒ 01, 04 (03+05), 08 (07+09), …. A lone bay aft of the last 40 ft bay is allowed only as the next odd number of the walk. Every listed number must be reached by the walk (loader error otherwise).

rowsInHold.description: Default number of rows in the hold. Odd count ⇒ row 00 on the centreline; odd rows to starboard, even rows to port.

rowsOnDeck.description: Default number of rows on deck (on the hatch covers and outboard pedestals).

tiersInHold.description: Default number of tiers in the hold, counted from structure.firstHoldTier.

tiersOnDeck.description: Default number of tiers on deck, counted from structure.firstDeckTier.

overrides.description: Per-bay exceptions to the default row/tier counts (e.g. narrower bays forward) and raised hold floors.

items.description: Row/tier counts for one bay position: a 40 ft bay (with its two 20 ft halves) or a lone 20 ft bay.

bay.description: Bay position this override applies to: a 40 ft bay (also covers its two 20 ft bays) or a lone 20 ft bay.

rowsInHold.description: Rows in the hold of this bay (0 = no hold stowage).

rowsOnDeck.description: Rows on deck in this bay (0 = no deck stowage).

tiersInHold.description: Tiers in the hold of this bay (0 = no hold stowage).

tiersOnDeck.description: Tiers on deck in this bay (0 = no deck stowage).

hold20ftAllowed.description: false = 40 ft cells only in this hold; 20 ft boxes may not be stowed below deck in this bay.

holdRowBaseTier.description: Raised hold floor (tank top / hopper in the forward and aft holds): row string ("04") → lowest hold tier of that row (even, ≥ structure.firstHoldTier). That tier stands on the raised floor at tank top + (baseTier − firstHoldTier)/2 × 2.591 m; tiers below it do not exist in that row. Keys stay 2-digit row strings.

gaps.description: Longitudinal gaps between bay positions: deckhouse (accommodation/bridge), funnel or plain gap.

items.description: A gap aft of one bay position.

afterBay.description: Bay position (40 ft bay or lone 20 ft bay) after (aft of) which the gap lies; not the last bay.

length_m.description: Gap length in metres, added to the distance between this bay and the next.

heightAboveDeck_m.description: Height in metres of the deckhouse/funnel above the main deck; 0 = flat gap. Give it for a deckhouse or funnel: without it (or with 0) the structure is drawn flat and the loader warns.

hatchCovers.description: Pontoon hatch covers. If omitted, every bay with hold rows gets generated covers with the defaults below. A bay with n hold rows gets min(panelsAcross, max(1, floor(n / 3))) generated panels (narrow bays get fewer; each still weighs weight_t, so give narrow bays realistic weights in overrides). Generated panel ids are "<bay>-<k>", k = 1, 2, … from port to starboard (e.g. "22-1", "22-2", "22-3"); length = bay length − 0.4 (pitch_m − 0.4 for a 40 ft bay, pitch_m/2 − 0.4 for a lone 20 ft bay), width = rows × rowPitch_m. The hold rows (port → starboard) are split SYMMETRICALLY over that many panels into contiguous groups: base = floor(rows / panels), remainder r. Odd panel count: the centre panel gets base + r. Even panel count: the remainder goes one row each to the two centre-most panels, pair by pair; a single row left over (odd row count, row 00) goes to the port-side centre panel. Examples (hold rows / panelsAcross): 15/3 → 5/5/5; 17/3 → 5/7/5; 16/3 → 5/6/5; 13/3 → 4/5/4; 7/3 → 4/3 (2 panels); 5/3 → 5 (1 panel); 13/2 → 7/6; 14/4 → 3/4/4/3; 15/4 → 3/5/4/3.

panelsAcross.description: Number of panels across a bay (athwartships), numbered from port to starboard; a narrow bay gets min(panelsAcross, max(1, floor(hold rows / 3))). Rows are split symmetrically (see hatchCovers).

thickness_m.description: Thickness in metres of a generated panel. Cover top = base of the first deck tier.

weight_t.description: Weight in tonnes of a generated panel (must not exceed the crane's rated load under spreader).

baysWithout.description: Bay positions without hatch covers (open-hatch bays). There the stack continues from hold to deck inside cell guides: the first deck tier over a hold row stands on the top hold tier of that row (which must be occupied), with no stacking-cone gap and no cover-underside limit. Deck rows beyond the hold width stand on pedestals as usual.

overrides.description: Explicit panel layouts that replace the generated panels of a bay.

items.description: Panel layout of one bay position.

bay.description: Bay position (40 ft bay or lone 20 ft bay) whose panels are defined here.

panels.description: Panels of this bay; together they must cover every hold row exactly once.

id.description: Panel id, unique on the vessel (convention "<bay>-<n>", e.g. "22-2"). Used by hatchCoverId and coverSeat.

rows.description: Hold rows covered by this panel ("04" strings canonical; integers accepted).

length_m.description: Panel length fore-and-aft in metres. Default bay length − 0.4.

width_m.description: Panel width athwartships in metres. Default number of rows × rowPitch_m.

thickness_m.description: Panel thickness in metres. Default hatchCovers.thickness_m.

weight_t.description: Panel weight in tonnes. Default hatchCovers.weight_t.

levels.description: Lashing bridge height in tiers, 0–4 (0 = no lashing bridges). Bridge top = cover top + levels × 2.591 m + (levels − 1) × 0.03 m. A 45 ft box on deck in a bay with a bridge fore or aft must stand with its base at or above the bridge top.

afterBays.description: "all" = a bridge aft of every bay position that is followed by another bay without a gap in between; or a list of bay positions with a bridge aft of them.

reeferPositions.description: Reefer plug positions (at least one block). If present, every RUNNING reefer (type RF with reeferSetpoint_C) must stand in a matching slot; an RF without a setpoint (empty or non-operating reefer) may stow anywhere. Lists accept integers or zero-padded strings.

bays.description: "all" or a list of bay positions (a 40 ft bay includes its two 20 ft bays; lone 20 ft bays by their own number).

rows.description: "all" or a list of rows ("04" strings canonical; integers accepted).

tiers.description: "all" or a list of tiers (even integers canonical, e.g. 82, 84, 86; "82" strings accepted).

decorativeFill.description: Generated "stay" (ROB) boxes in bays that no bayPlan entry or move references, for looks and collisions. The generator only builds valid stacks: support rules, hold height under the covers, no 45 ft box inside lashing-bridge height next to a bridge, and no 45 ft boxes in the same row and tier of adjacent bays when 13.716 m exceeds the bay pitch (their overhangs would collide).

enabled.description: true = fill untouched bays with generated boxes.

density.description: Fraction of available slots to fill, 0–1.

seed.description: Random seed for the generated fill (same seed = same stow).

bayPlan.description: Boxes on board on arrival (may be empty). Each entry: container fields + slot + status.

loadList.description: Export boxes that arrive by terminal tractor / AGV for loading. Required when any move is a "load".

workQueue.description: Crane moves in the order they are to be worked (at least one).

yardSide.description: Yard side under and behind the crane: horizontal transport, truck lanes, quay buffer, hatch cover laydowns and truck timing.

transport.description: Horizontal transport: "terminalTractor" (terminal tractor + chassis) or "agv" (automated guided vehicle).

chassisType.description: Chassis behind the terminal tractor: "combo2040" (1 × 40/45 ft or 2 × 20 ft on twistlocks) or "bombCart" (terminal (yard) chassis with corner guides and no twistlocks: 1 × 40/45 ft or 2 × 20 ft in the guides). Required for terminalTractor, not allowed for agv.

single20Position.description: Default position of a single 20 ft box on a chassis/AGV: "front" = the end towards the tractor unit (gooseneck end), i.e. the end facing the lane's driving direction (for an AGV: the end facing its driving direction); "rear" = the other end; "centre" = mid-length.

lanes.description: Truck lanes under the crane (at least one), running along the quay.

id.description: Lane id used in move locations, e.g. "L2".

fromWatersideRail_m.description: Lane centreline in metres from the waterside rail: positive = waterside, negative = landside (between the rails 0 … −30.48, backreach beyond). Lanes run the full length of the crane span: the 2.44 m lane band must stay clear of each rail centreline ± 1.5 m (crane legs / gantry bogies) and must not overlap another lane, a buffer slot or a laydown.

use.description: Which legs may use the lane: "discharge" (vessel → lane: discharges and restow leg 1), "load" (lane → vessel: loads and restow leg 2) or "both".

direction.description: Driving direction along the quay: "increasing" or "decreasing" quay marks. The front of a chassis/AGV faces this direction.

quayBuffer.description: Quay buffer stack for restows via the quay and discharges to the buffer (absent = no buffer). Loads never come from the buffer. Slots are laid out along the quay in the direction of increasing quay marks at 13.4 m pitch (40 ft) or 6.8 m (20 ft).

fromWatersideRail_m.description: Buffer row centreline in metres from the waterside rail (negative = landside). The slots (box width) must stay clear of each rail centreline ± 1.5 m and of every lane band.

quayMark_m.description: Quay mark in metres of the centre of slot 1. Default: the resolved crane start mark (crane.startQuayMark_m, or the quay mark of crane.startAtBay).

maxTiers.description: Maximum stacking height in the buffer, in tiers (1–3).

slotSize.description: Buffer slot length in feet: 20 or 40.

idPrefix.description: Prefix for buffer slot ids; slots are "<prefix>01", "<prefix>02", …

hatchCoverLaydowns.description: Quay laydown areas for hatch cover panels.

id.description: Laydown id used in move locations, e.g. "HCL1".

fromWatersideRail_m.description: Laydown centre in metres from the waterside rail (negative = landside, usually in the backreach). The widest panel landed there must stay clear of each rail centreline ± 1.5 m and of every lane band, and must not overlap a buffer slot or another laydown.

quayMark_m.description: Quay mark in metres of the laydown centre. Default: the resolved crane start mark (crane.startQuayMark_m, or the quay mark of crane.startAtBay).

maxStack.description: Maximum number of panels stacked on this laydown.

truckTiming.description: When trucks/AGVs arrive under the crane. Omitted fields take their fixed format defaults (schema v1).

mode.description: "justInTime" = trucks are called for the next lookAheadMoves moves; "fixedInterval" = a truck arrives every interval_s.

lookAheadMoves.description: justInTime: number of upcoming moves for which trucks are called.

travelTime_s.description: justInTime: seconds from call to arrival under the crane.

jitter_s.description: Uniform random ± variation of arrival times, in seconds.

seed.description: Random seed for arrival jitter and stop accuracy.

stopAccuracy_m.description: Standard deviation in metres of the stop position along the lane. Default 0.30 for terminalTractor, 0.03 for agv.

departDelay_s.description: Seconds a truck/AGV waits after the spreader has unlocked/lifted before it drives off.

allOf.$comment: agv: chassisType not allowed; stopAccuracy_m default 0.03.

environment.description: Weather and sea. All fields optional; an omitted field takes its fixed format default (schema v1).

wind.description: Wind acting on spreader and box (adds lateral force and sway).

fromDirection_deg.description: True direction the wind blows FROM, in degrees (meteorological convention).

gustSpeed_kn.description: Gust peak speed in knots (≥ speed_kn). Default = speed_kn, i.e. no gusts.

gustInterval_s.description: Random time between gusts in seconds, as [min, max] (the loader checks min ≤ max).

timeOfDay.description: Local time of day "HH:MM" (24 h), drives lighting.

visibility_m.description: Visibility in metres. Default depends on weather.

seaState.description: Sea state on the Douglas scale 0–9 (visual only).

crane.description: The STS crane working this scenario and its start state. Give the gantry start as EXACTLY ONE of startQuayMark_m or startAtBay; the resolved start mark is also the default quayMark_m of the quay buffer and the hatch cover laydowns.

profile.description: profileId of a CraneProfile asset, e.g. "SPP-65" (the loader lists the known profiles).

id.description: Crane number shown on the HUD, e.g. "QC04".

startQuayMark_m.description: Gantry start position: real quay mark in metres of the crane centreline (midway between the waterside legs). Exactly one of startQuayMark_m / startAtBay.

startAtBay.description: Gantry start position: the crane starts abeam the centre of this bay (a 40 ft bay, a lone 20 ft bay, or one 20 ft half of a 40 ft bay). Exactly one of startQuayMark_m / startAtBay. The loader prints the resolved quay mark.

startTrolley_m.description: fromWatersideRail_m of the trolley at start: + waterside, − landside. Trolley start position in metres from the waterside rail (positive = under the boom / outreach, negative = between the legs and backreach).

startHoistHeight_m.description: Start hoist height in metres: spreader underside (twistlock plane) above the quay apron.

boomRaisedAtStart.description: true = boom starts raised (vessel arrival / departure position).

twinLiftEnabled.description: true = twin-twenty spreader available; required for twinLift moves.

antiSwayOnAtStart.description: true = the crane's anti-sway system (type per CraneProfile / SwayProfile) is switched on at start.

softLimits.description: Gantry soft limits for this scenario (inside the rail-end hard limits).

minQuayMark_m.description: Lowest quay mark in metres the crane centreline may travel to.

maxQuayMark_m.description: Highest quay mark in metres the crane centreline may travel to.

blockedZones.description: Quay stretches the crane must not gantry into (e.g. neighbouring crane).

fromQuayMark_m.description: Start of the blocked zone, quay mark in metres.

toQuayMark_m.description: End of the blocked zone, quay mark in metres.

reason.description: Why the zone is blocked, shown on the HUD (e.g. "QC05 working bay 30").

oneOf.$comment: Start given as a quay mark.

rules.description: Pass/fail thresholds and targets. All fields optional. Unlike the rest of the format, an omitted rules field is taken from the rules-defaults profile (tunable in the app's tuning panel); the defaults shown here are its factory values. Write a field to pin it for this scenario.

hardLanding_mps.description: Hard-landing threshold: downward speed at first contact, in m/s.

placementTolerance_cm.description: Maximum position error at set-down, in cm.

yawTolerance_deg.description: Maximum yaw (skew) error at set-down, in degrees.

maxSwayAtPlacement_cm.description: Maximum spreader sway amplitude at set-down, in cm.

moveTimeTargets_s.description: Target move time per move type, in seconds.

discharge.description: Target seconds for a discharge move.

load.description: Target seconds for a load move.

restow.description: Target seconds for a restow move.

hatchcover.description: Target seconds for a hatch cover move.

wrongSlot.description: Set-down in the wrong slot: "fail" = the move fails; "penalise" = the move counts with a penalty.

windStopLimit_kn.description: Terminal wind-stop policy in knots. The effective limit is the LOWER of this and the CraneProfile inServiceWindLimit_kn (crane design limit, 40 kn for SPP-65): rules may only tighten it (the loader warns if this is above the profile value, and if the wind exceeds the effective limit).

allOf.$comment: loadList is required when any move is a load.

slotString.description: Vessel slot as bay-row-tier "BB-RR-TT" (bay 2–3 digits, row and tier 2 digits), e.g. "22-04-84". Odd bay = 20 ft bay; even bay = 40 ft bay made of the odd bays either side (22 = 21 + 23). Bay numbers follow the vessel layout (vessel.bays): normally 02, 06, 10, …; with lone 20 ft bays (vessel.bays.twentyOnlyBays) the numbering shifts, e.g. [1] ⇒ 01, 04 (03+05), 08 (07+09), …. Rows from the centreline outward: 00 on the centreline (odd row count only), odd rows to starboard, even rows to port. Tiers are even: 02, 04, … in the hold, 82, 84, … on deck. The loader checks that the bay, row and tier exist on this vessel and that the bay parity matches the box length.

rowString.description: Row number, always 2 digits: "00" = centreline, odd (01, 03, …) to starboard, even (02, 04, …) to port.

rowListItem.description: Row in a list: a 2-digit string ("04", canonical) or an integer (4). The loader normalises both; the same row twice is an error.

anyOf.description: Row number as an integer (0 = centreline).

tierNumber.description: Tier number (even integer): 2, 4, … in the hold, 82, 84, … on deck.

tierListItem.description: Tier in a list: an even integer (82, canonical) or a 2-digit string ("82"). The loader normalises both; the same tier twice is an error.

anyOf.description: Tier number as a 2-digit string, even, "02"–"98".

bayNumber.description: Bay position number: a 40 ft bay (even, e.g. 22 = 20 ft bays 21 + 23) or a lone 20 ft bay listed in vessel.bays.twentyOnlyBays (odd). The schema checks the range only; the loader checks that the bay exists on this vessel and lists the nearest valid bays if not.

bayListItem.description: Bay position in a list: an integer (22, canonical) or a zero-padded string ("22" or "022"). The loader normalises both; the same bay twice is an error.

anyOf.description: Bay number as a zero-padded 2–3 digit string, not zero.

twentyOnlyBayItem.description: Lone 20 ft bay number (odd): an integer (1, canonical) or a zero-padded string ("01" or "001").

anyOf.description: Odd bay number as a zero-padded 2–3 digit string.

containerId.description: Container number per ISO 6346, no spaces: 3-letter owner code, equipment category U (freight container), J (detachable equipment) or Z (trailer/chassis), 6-digit serial number and check digit, e.g. "CSQU3054383". The loader verifies the check digit and reports the expected one.

id.description: Identifier: letters, digits, "-", "_" or ".", starting with a letter or digit, at most 32 characters.

quayMark.description: Real quay mark in metres (as painted on the quay), from mark 0. Always written as the real mark, whichever way the marks run (quay.marksIncreaseTo decides where it lies in the world).

fromWatersideRail.description: Transverse position in metres from the waterside rail centreline: positive = waterside (under the boom, outreach), negative = landside (landside rail at −30.48, beyond it the backreach).

unLocode.description: UN/LOCODE: 2-letter country code + 3-character location code, e.g. "NLRTM".

oog.description: Out-of-gauge overhang beyond the standard box envelope, in centimetres. Only for type FR (flat rack) or OT (open top). Nothing may be stowed on top of an OOG box.

overHeight_cm.description: Over-height above the top of the corner castings, in cm. Counts in the lift-height check (box height + overHeight_cm/100).

overWidthPort_cm.description: Over-width to port (as stowed), in cm.

overWidthStarboard_cm.description: Over-width to starboard (as stowed), in cm.

containerRules.description: Type-dependent rules shared by bayPlan and loadList entries.

allOf.$comment: Type HC (high-cube dry van) requires height HC.
Type DV (standard dry van) requires height standard: a high-cube dry van is type HC.
oog only on flat racks (FR) and open tops (OT).

container.description: A container (box): identity, dimensions, type, weight and operator. Used as loadList entry and, with slot and status, as bayPlan entry.

size.description: Box length in feet: 20, 40 or 45. 20 ft boxes stow in odd bays, 40/45 ft in even bays; 45 ft only on deck, never in 40 ft cell guides.

height.description: Box height: "standard" (8'6" = 2.591 m) or "HC" high cube (9'6" = 2.896 m).

type.description: ISO type group: "DV" standard-height dry van (requires height "standard"), "HC" high-cube dry van (requires height "HC"), "RF" reefer, "OT" open top, "TK" tank, "FR" flat rack. A high-cube dry van is always written type "HC", height "HC".

grossWeight_t.description: Gross mass in tonnes (tare + cargo; VGM). Must satisfy tare ≤ gross ≤ max gross from the ContainerCatalog (default 30.48 t) — checked by the loader. An empty box is gross = tare.

tare_t.description: Tare mass in tonnes. Default: per size/type from the ContainerCatalog.

operator.description: Line operator code, 2–4 upper-case letters/digits (e.g. "MSK", "CMA"); sets the box colour from the OperatorPalette.

colour.description: Box colour override as "#RRGGBB" (otherwise the OperatorPalette colour of the operator).

pod.description: Port of discharge (POD) as UN/LOCODE, e.g. "NLRTM".

reeferSetpoint_C.description: Reefer temperature setpoint in °C. Only allowed for type "RF". A reefer WITH a setpoint is a running reefer and must stand in a vessel.reeferPositions slot (if reeferPositions is given); a reefer without it (empty or non-operating reefer, NOR) may stow anywhere.

loadListEntry.description: Export box that arrives under the crane by terminal tractor / AGV and is loaded by a "load" move.

bayPlanEntry.description: A box on board on arrival: all container fields plus its slot and status.

slot.description: Stowage position on arrival as bay-row-tier, e.g. "22-04-84". 20 ft boxes use odd bays, 40/45 ft boxes even (40 ft) bays.

status.description: Status of the box on arrival: "discharge" = to be discharged at this port; "stay" = remains on board (ROB); "restow" = to be shifted during this call (restow on board or via the quay).

vessel.description: Vessel slot bay-row-tier, e.g. "22-04-84". For a twin lift write the 40 ft bay number ("22-00-82" = 21-00-82 + 23-00-82).

locationLane.description: Truck lane location (terminal tractor chassis or AGV under the crane).

lane.description: Truck lane id from yardSide.lanes, e.g. "L2".

chassisPosition.description: Position of a single 20 ft box on the chassis/AGV: "front" = the end towards the tractor unit (gooseneck end), i.e. the end facing the lane's driving direction (for an AGV: the end facing its driving direction); "rear" = the other end; "centre" = mid-length. Only for single 20 ft moves; default: yardSide.single20Position.

locationBuffer.description: Quay buffer slot location (quay stack under/behind the crane).

buffer.description: Quay buffer slot id, e.g. "QB01" (prefix yardSide.quayBuffer.idPrefix + 2-digit slot number).

tier.description: Tier in the buffer stack, 1 = on the quay. Default: next free tier (pick: top box). Max yardSide.quayBuffer.maxTiers.

locationCoverSeat.description: Hatch cover panel's own seat on the vessel (on the coamings).

coverSeat.description: Hatch cover panel id whose seat is meant, e.g. "22-2". A panel only goes back to its own seat.

locationLaydown.description: Hatch cover laydown area on the quay.

laydown.description: Hatch cover laydown id from yardSide.hatchCoverLaydowns, e.g. "HCL1".

location.description: Pick-up or set-down location: an object with exactly one of "vessel", "lane" (+ optional "chassisPosition"), "buffer" (+ optional "tier"), "coverSeat" or "laydown".

move.description: One crane move in the work queue.

id.description: Move id shown on the HUD and in the results, e.g. "M001". Default "M001", "M002", … by position in the queue. Must be unique.

type.description: Move type: "discharge" (vessel → lane | buffer), "load" (lane → vessel only: export boxes arrive by truck/AGV), "restow" (vessel → vessel = direct shift on board; via the quay: vessel → buffer then buffer → vessel, or vessel → lane then lane → vessel — between the legs the box waits on the quay buffer or on the truck/AGV; leg 2 comes back on any lane whose use is load or both), "hatchcover" (coverSeat → laydown or laydown → coverSeat).

containerId.description: Box to move (ISO 6346). Required for discharge, load and restow; not allowed for hatchcover. In a twin lift: the forward box (lower odd 20 ft bay).

twinLift.description: true = twin-twenty lift: two 20 ft boxes end to end in the same row and tier of the two 20 ft bays of one 40 ft bay, lifted together on the twin-twenty spreader. Requires crane.twinLiftEnabled and twinContainerId. Not allowed at all on hatchcover moves. Until Phase 3 the WorkQueue splits a twin lift into two single 20 ft moves (forward box first).

twinContainerId.description: Aft box of a twin lift (higher odd 20 ft bay). Required when twinLift is true, not allowed otherwise.

hatchCoverId.description: Hatch cover panel id, e.g. "22-2". Required for hatchcover moves, not allowed for other types.

from.description: Where the spreader picks up (vessel, lane, buffer, coverSeat or laydown).

to.description: Where the spreader sets down (vessel, lane, buffer, coverSeat or laydown).

note.description: Optional instruction shown on the HUD for this move.

allOf.$comment: hatchcover: hatchCoverId required, container and twin-lift fields not allowed (not even twinLift: false), coverSeat <-> laydown. Other types: containerId required, hatchCoverId not allowed.
load: lane -> vessel only (export boxes arrive by truck/AGV).
restow: vessel -> vessel (shift on board); via the quay buffer: vessel -> buffer, buffer -> vessel; via a truck lane: vessel -> lane, lane -> vessel.
twinContainerId only together with twinLift: true.
